killedBy: the screen gate: a state whose subject IS a page error (issue #861) fails on a DIFFERENT error, so the declaration cannot launder an unrelated regression
why: Turns a state's page-error declaration into a blanket amnesty. `screen.startup.entry-unparseable` declares the SyntaxError it exists to photograph; with the match dropped, any other error on that page -- a real regression in the boot path, or a second error riding alongside the expected one -- is accepted as the design and written into the baseline. The state would keep passing while no longer demonstrating what it was written for, which is the specific way a gate stops being one.
